query:
SELECT weekNumber, weekStartDate, headcount, updatedAt
FROM attendance_weekly 
WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber BETWEEN 17 AND 20
  AND campus = 'Canton' AND subgroup = 'Revolution Canton Check-In'
ORDER BY weekNumber;
